# Bun:  transform

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Bun crypto transforms can be executed by providing an exact method name and parameters to the DecipherChaCha20Poly1305 object. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact method signature, required parameters, and accepted return values for the Bun crypto API. Agents must supply SOURCE FACT REQUIRED placeholders for the exact method signature, error codes, and return shape before the kit is finalized.

Search intents:
- Bun crypto transform
- Bun DecipherChaCha20Poly1305 transform
- Bun crypto API

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/bun-crypto-transform --json
